summary: Implements String.prototype.codePointAt in its own file. The steps run in spec order: RequireObjectCoercible, ToString, ToIntegerOrInfinity, length check returning undefined, then CodePointAt and returning the code point as a Number. The local code_point_at helper follows the CodePointAt algorithm: the BMP fast path, the trailing-surrogate and end-of-string unpaired cases, the second-unit check, and the surrogate-pair formula. No test-specific branches, no swallowed abrupt completions, no made-up values. The only fallbacks are unwrap_or(0) on indexes the caller has already bounds-checked, so they are unreachable. The removed spec NOTE comment is cosmetic.
